Full product details
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

The Carry-On is our smallest suitcase, sized to fit in all overhead bins and perfect for quick trips.

  • Fits overhead on most major airlines
  • 5-7 outfits
  • TSA combination lock
  • Nests in checked luggage

Meet our award-winning Classic suitcases—designed by travelers, for travelers. The Carry-On is our smallest suitcase, sized to fit in all overhead bins and perfect for any quick trip. It features a lightweight, durable hard shell that's been rigorously tested and a signature interior compression system that helps you pack, organize and protect more. Details like an easy-grip top handle, additional underside grab handle, and smooth-gliding wheels make it easier than ever to maneuver and lift your suitcase. Better travel starts here.

  • Durable, lightweight 100% polycarbonate shell
  • Premium 360 smooth-gliding wheels for better maneuverability
  • High-grade, quick-release trolley handle with 2 adjustable height settings
  • Ergonomic, reverse coil zippers for easy access and extra security
  • TSA-approved combination lock
  • Double-buckle compression pad to help you pack more in
  • Best-in-class interior organization (three mesh pockets, plus one hanging pocket)
  • Additional underside grab handle for easy lifting
  • Water-resistant polyester laundry bag with a drawstring closure
  • Includes a black luggage tag, crafted from 50% recycled leather
  • Meets carry-on requirements for most major airlines
  • Nests inside The Medium, The Large, and The Trunk

Our Classic suitcases are shipped in exterior packaging that is 100% recyclable. Learn more.

Exterior measurements 21.7" x 14.4" x 9"
Interior measurements 20.1" x 13.9" x 7.5"

Capacity 41 L

We offer free returns and exchanges on unused items within 100 days. Learn more.

Every suitcase comes with Away LifetimeCare™ Coverage, which includes repair support for the life of your suitcase and covers functional damage from manufacturing defects or unexpected rough travel. For the first five years, repairs are complimentary. If we're unable to repair covered damage, we'll provide up to one replacement within that period. After five years, repair support continues, and round trip shipping stays on us. Learn more.

For extended support, you can add LifetimeCare™ Pro at checkout to receive 10 years of complimentary repairs and up to two replacements within that same period. Learn more.

If you purchased your suitcase prior to April 14, 2026, see warranty details here.

Designed to stand up to miles of travel

Mileage that won't give out

Every Away handle design is tested through 1,500 pulls at up to 60 lbs — so it holds up when you grab, lift, or drag it on your next trip.

Wheels that never quit

Before your suitcase logs its first miles with you, it’s already gone the distance. Every design is rolled 480 New York city blocks of simulated travel to test wear and glide.

Zippers built to keep up

The zipper is the last thing you want to think about mid-trip. That’s why we test them up to 8,000 times before they find their way to you.

Built to stick the landing

Baggage handlers aren't always gentle. Our luggage is loaded up to 60 lbs and repeatedly dropped every which way at 10° F — putting the shell to the ultimate test.

The details that make a big difference

A TSA-approved combination lock safeguards your essentials without slowing you down at security. Engineered for travel, it keeps your bag closed tight and your mind at ease—mile after mile.

We added a handle underneath to make our lightweight suitcases even easier to lift. You’ll thank us at the baggage carousel.

Keep your dirty clothes separate with a drawstring laundry bag made of 100% recycled polyester.

Add up to three letters in your choice of three placements. It’s the easiest way to ensure no one else walks off with your bag—because yours is literally one-of-a-kind.

Between sizes?

Our customers often prefer the The Bigger Carry-On due to its common, larger size. If you’re deciding between the two, we recommend purchasing The Bigger Carry-On upfront.

Questions? We're here to help

The Carry-On is the smaller, standard international-compliant size. It measures 21.7" x 14.4" x 9" and weighs 7.5 lbs (41L capacity). The Bigger Carry-On is approximately one inch larger in each dimension (22.7" x 15.4" x 9.6") and offers 8 more liters of packing space (49L). You can compare The Carry-On and The Bigger Carry-On in more detail here!
The Away Carry-On measures 21.7" x 14.4" x 9" (Exterior) and weighs 7.5 lbs, with a capacity of 41 Liters. This size is designed to fit in the overhead bins of most major airlines, including international carriers.
We recommend using the signature interior compression system to maximize space and secure your items. For best results, utilize packing cubes for organization and roll softer clothing items like knits and t-shirts to prevent wrinkles, while folding more structured garments.
The Carry-On is generally best for 3–5 day trips, or longer if you are a light packer or combine it with a personal item bag. It's sized for about 5-7 full outfits.
